author: devin-ai (Cognition)
name: Int6 MLP3x + EMA + XSA4 + TTT + Partial RoPE + LN Scale + GPTQ-lite
blurb: 11L 512d MLP3x GQA8/4. Int6 per-row quant + GPTQ-lite + zstd-22. EMA decay=0.997, XSA on last 4 layers, Partial RoPE 16 dims, LN Scale=1, TTT 20 epochs (lr=0.008, momentum=0.9, freeze_blocks=0), Muon+AdamW (LR=0.025, WD=0.04, mom=0.99), BigramHash(2048,128), sliding window eval stride=64. seq_len=2048, batch=786K, warmdown=3500.
